title: Practice 9: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Его бросили в тюрьму за ___ (грабёж, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: He was thrown in prison for robbery.
exercises.why: **грабёж → грабёж** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Accusative = nominative.
**ветка → ветку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета. Ending -а → -у.

exercises.prompt: A drowning man will catch at a straw.
exercises.why: **соломинка → соломинку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета. Ending -а → -у.

exercises.q: Том выступал за ___ (прерывание, acc. sg.) миссии.
exercises.prompt: Tom was in favor of aborting the mission.
exercises.why: **прерывание → прерывание** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.q: Том мог бы сойти за ___ (тинейджер, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom could pass for a teenager.
exercises.why: **тинейджер → тинейджера** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate. Declines like студент. Ending — (no ending) → -а.
**вторжение → вторжение** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.q: Его арестовали за ___ (растрата, acc. sg.) госсредств.
exercises.prompt: He was arrested for abusing public funds.
exercises.why: **растрата → растрату** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета. Ending -а → -у.

exercises.q: Я держал его за ___ (воротник, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I held him by the collar.
exercises.why: **воротник → воротник** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.q: Глобальные климатические изменения могут быть ответственны за ___ (вымирание, acc. sg.) динозавров.
exercises.prompt: Global climatic changes may have been responsible for the extinction of the dinosaurs.
exercises.why: **вымирание → вымирание** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.q: Он отчитал меня за ___ (оплошность, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: He reprimanded me for my oversight.
exercises.why: **оплошность → оплошность** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like часть. Accusative = nominative.
